title: Detecting Training Data of Large Language Models via Expectation Maximization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a membership inference attack method (EM-MIA) and a corresponding benchmark (OLMoMIA) to detect if specific data was used in training an LLM. While it mentions ethical risks like privacy breaches in the introduction as a motivation for the research, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
